zones.name: Other-Reader Commons
zones.purpose: Awareness of others (AO): asking instead of assuming, listening without preparing a reply

zones.name: Repairer's Hall
zones.purpose: Repair (RR): coming down, apologising properly, saying the hard thing kindly

zones.name: Room-Reader Plaza
zones.purpose: Reading the room (RM): where the energy is, who is idle, the moment before it goes wrong

zones.name: Practitioner Workshop
zones.purpose: Emotion at work (EW): feedback that can be used, saying no at work, emotional labour
